text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 20 · 珍珠白温泉长廊.
Environment:  An original historic Alpine thermal bath, long narrow pale-aqua pool beneath cream vaulted arches, milky daylight enters through tall frosted windows and a roof lantern. Pale limestone floor, understated geometric ivory tiles, a folded white towel on a warm-brown bench to left, repeated arches recede to a small sunlit alcove. Gently steaming water with no obscuring fog, low-contrast reflections, central walkway usable. Original quiet period spa architecture, photoreal natural textures, pearl white with restrained seafoam. No swimmers, figures, statues, murals of people or faces, no dark cave mood.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 20 · 珍珠白温泉长廊. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
